description: Animate by Schwartz, a 4,034-byte intro that won the PC 4K intro competition at Assembly '95, running from its original files in your browser.
about: Animate is Schwartz's 4K intro for MS-DOS, which won the PC 4K intro competition at Assembly '95, held from 10 to 13 August 1995 in Helsinki. Butterflies fly over a green field; then a metallic vase turns in front of a gray background, stops and reveals two faces, and the intro's name zooms out.
It has no sound. It ends by itself after about 48 seconds; Escape ends it at once.
In 2020 Schwartz published it with its source code at github.com/mtreinik/animate, under the MIT License.
released: Assembly '95: first of 15 in the PC 4K intro competition, with 2,100 points.
